Understanding people

I trusted the process.

A passage from Aaron’s own account.

A closer lookOpen the shared interactive reader ↗

The interactive example has its own motion control. Scroll inside it if you need more room.

Aaron’s account, in wording open to revision

Personal account · working draft

I experienced my children becoming alienated from me. It broke my heart. My marriage suffered, and my wife left.

I took kenosis seriously. I trusted the process. Along the way, I had to remember to care. In the intensity of everything, it could become totalizing.

Words used here
kenosis
A Christian term often translated as “self-emptying.” Here it means using power while making room for others to act.
totalizing
Taking over so much attention that other things become hard to notice.
